items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 24 at 4:56AM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
A wet system continues to move over the southern panhandle through
tonight, bringing an extended period of moderate to heavy rain for
the southern panhandle. Highest rain rates are expected through
this morning, perhaps around 0.2 to 0.4 inches per hour at times,
primarily for Ketchikan, Metlakatla, and Misty Fjords. Nearly 1.5 to
2.5 inches of rainfall has been observed since Sunday, with over 3
inches in some surrounding higher elevations. Through tonight, storm
event total rainfall of 2 to 3.
